decision.image: Original assets/cover-v3.webp restored; generated portrait is no longer loaded on the homepage.
decision.layout: Full-bleed photograph, centered lower campaign copy, gradual warm shadow; existing type families retained.
decision.initial_mobile_header: Only centered wordmark; Menu and header First access hidden visually until scrolling more than 32px or keyboard focus. Hero First access remains visible.
decision.logo: clamp(136px,37.7vw,156px): 148.16px at 393px viewport. Scrolled logo clamp(126px,36vw,146px).
decision.reason: Long light-stroke wordmark needs more width than short dense marks; removal of adjacent controls provides emphasis without oversizing.

references.takeaway: Slender centered wordmark and separated lower campaign message.
Compact four-letter serif wordmark; width cannot be copied to a nine-letter thin wordmark.
Compact commerce header; avoid transferring its utility-led scale to a campaign arrival.
Long wordmark provides relevant proportion reference, while keeping brand type untouched.
Heavier letterforms hold presence at a smaller width; surrounding space matters.

validation.hero_cta: Visible without scrolling at all three sizes; existing invitation anchor preserved.
validation.scope: Homepage HTML and dedicated mobile hero CSS only; desktop uses existing image and composition.
